name: Omni Battlegrounds
desc:
Diverse combos & powers, discover and unlock rare skills that others don't have!
📱💻 🎮You can play on any device. (TABLET, PC, MOBILE, XBOX/Play Station)
Please like the game for more quality updates🩷
🖥️ Controls:
G - ultimate mode
F - block
Q - dash
Q (while ragdolled) - ragdoll cancel/evasive
(Automatic Run Direction W)
Left Click - punch
B - emote wheel (Closed for develop)
❗One-person project, every update kinda slow❗
